description: This file defines the UPSShippingQuote class, which implements shipping quote functionality for UPS by interfacing with UPS's online API. It contains methods for validating configuration and retrieving shipping quotes based on package details, country, and store data. It also includes an inner class UPSParsedElements for parsing UPS API responses.

classes.name: UPSShippingQuote
classes.description: Implements shipping quote logic for UPS via their API, including configuration validation and quote retrieval.

classes.name: UPSParsedElements
classes.description: Helper class to parse and hold UPS API response elements including status, errors, and shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the UPS shipping module configuration, ensuring required keys and options are set.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Contacts UPS API to get shipping quotes based on package details, destination, and store configuration.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Returns custom configuration for the module; implementation here does nothing special.
